note: Finviz and direct API access were blocked, so the screens could not be run in bulk. Candidates were picked likely candidates by sector reasoning and checked each one against stockanalysis.com statistics, overview and financials pages (close Fri 2026-10-23), plus company earnings releases (SEC 8-K, StockTitan). Price, market cap, SMA50/200, RSI, average volume, short float, ROE, ROIC, operating margin, D/E, current ratio, forward P/E and P/FCF come from the stockanalysis statistics pages. Quarterly EPS and sales y/y come from the earnings releases. 5-year growth is a CAGR calculated by the agent from stockanalysis annual figures: the base year (FY-5) is backed out of the FY-4 value and its stated growth, and the end year is the latest full fiscal year. 'EPS growth this year' uses year-to-date EPS against the prior-year YTD, or company guidance against the prior fiscal year, because Finviz consensus-estimate data was not available. 6-month performance could not be sourced for any name; stockanalysis history pages show only about 50 trading days. The session's web-search limit (200 calls, shared across agents) ran out before more names could be checked, including CAG, KHC, LYB, STZ and DOW as shorts. Names checked that FAILED: EOG (RSI 75.7; 5y EPS base FY2020 was negative), COP (ROE 14.2%, RSI 76.8), RMD as a swing long (RSI 77.2), PAYC (D/E 1.72), AMAT (P/FCF 53), QCOM (D/E 0.55), ADBE (D/E 0.58, current ratio 0.77), CPRT (5y EPS CAGR about 9.8%), GS as a swing long (price below SMA50/200), FANG (ROE 3.5%, TTM EPS depressed).
